import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long x = sc.nextLong();
        long y = sc.nextLong();
        long n = sc.nextLong();
        
        double min = 1e30;
        long ansA = 0, ansB = 0;
        
        for (long i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            long a = x * i / y;
            double d = Math.abs((double) x / y - (double) a / i);
            if (d < min) {
                min = d;
                ansA = a;
                ansB = i;
            }
            
            d = Math.abs((double) x / y - (double) (a + 1) / i);
            if (d < min) {
                min = d;
                ansA = a + 1;
                ansB = i;
            }
        }
        
        System.out.println(ansA + "/" + ansB);
        sc.close();
    }
}
